dogecoin.text: Not interested. I don’t give a damn about Dogecoin. Now I don’t see anymore of that in my social feed.

Haha!!! Elon Musk ditches Bitcoin. I have to say that although I am not fan of him but this is good. Good move by Elon Musk due to concerns of climate change & fossil fuel use. So no more of Bitcoin payments for Tesla. Really bad news for cryptocurrencies including Dogecoin.

Take That to the likes of Bitcoin, Dogecoin & other cryptocurrencies. Cryptic tweet from Elon Musk. It is really a good move for Mr Musk despite being not fan of him. Cryptocurrency should never be the replacement for physical currency. Physical money from Pound, Euro to Dollar.
